name: Floods
overview: Scripture reveals that floods are a powerful demonstration of God's sovereign judgment and mercy. The flood in Noah's time was sent to destroy all flesh due to human wickedness, yet God remembered Noah and caused the waters to recede, preserving life (Genesis 6:17; 8:1). The Psalms emphasize God's authority over the floods, portraying Him as reigning eternally above the stormy waters and waves (Psalms 29:10; 93:3; 107:25). Isaiah reminds us that just as God swore never to flood the earth again, He promises steadfast mercy and restraint toward His people (Isaiah 54:9).
